description: The declared constraint set — every entry is a constraint the corrosion predicate watches. Narrowing this set fires the check on itself (self-reference). The predicate is only as good as the set it watches.

constraints.description: The declared constraint set itself — narrowing it fires the check on itself, because a check about suppressing checks can be killed by the exact move it catches
The Rules awaiting physics section — prose IOUs for enforcement. Each retires when physics covers it; removing one without a ruling is corrosion.
Law 9: 'there is no triage authority — not environmental, not pre-existing, not out of scope.' The vocabulary of the plaster move.
